stances.summary: Endorses Pope Francis legacy, expresses hope for successor
stances.quote: The world has been blessed by the voice and example of Pope Francis. May Pope Leo XIV likewise draw upon the best of humankind and lead toward the Savior, Jesus Christ.

stances.summary: Celebrates Jimmy Carter's faith, service, and democratic legacy
stances.quote: A man of character and deep faith, Jimmy Carter will be remembered as more than a president. He leaves behind a legacy of service to others, love of family, and devotion to country and democracy. He is home again, reunited with his beloved wife, Rosalynn.

stances.summary: Praises Lindsey Graham's support for Ukrainian freedom
stances.quote: Lindsey Graham’s dedication to the cause of freedom inspired the oppressed and chastened the tyrants. A most fitting tribute to his life will be the unwavering support for the people of Ukraine.

stances.summary: Calls for urgent AI safeguards to prevent weapons, pathogens, unemployment, surveillance risks

stances.summary: Praises departing senator Cassidy's healthcare expertise and character
stances.quote: The Senate to now lose an exceptionally brilliant and creative mind, an MD who chairs healthcare, and a person of character. Bill Cassidy’s departure is a loss for the country.

stances.quote: Congratulations to Utah’s newest senator—@RepJohnCurtis! Our state is fortunate to have your continued service in Washington and the Senate is fortunate to have you. Wishing you and your team much success.
